LadderKey: In an elite arena in the middle of the level. You can exit if, when you enter, you go on top of the vine's top end.
TeleportKey: In an elite arena somewhere in the level. For now, you can't exit it without the Spider Rune or Teleportation Rune.
CustomKey: In a mandatory elite arena at the start of the level.
BreakableGroundKey: In an elite arena somewhere in the level. You can open the exit door by interacting with it.
WallJumpKey: In an elite arena at the end of the asleep part of the level. For now, you can't exit it without the Spider Rune.
ExploKey: In an elite arena near the end of the level.
HomKey: Obtained after the cutscene after beating the Hand of the King.
BankUnlock: Obtained at the start of the next run.
RichterDashKey: First Rune available in Richter Mode.
RichterUppercutKey: Second Rune available in Richter Mode.
FastBow: To the left of where you spawn in the Prisoners' Quarters.
P_Disengage: On top of where you spawn in the Prisoners' Quarters.
RoyalGardener: After the teleportation monolith leading to the Dilapidated Arboretum.
BroadSword: Found on the Tutorial Knight's corpse next to the exit leading to the Promenade. The corpse appears on the fourth run.
TrainingUnlock: Found on the Tutorial Knight's corpse next to the exit leading to the Promenade, after getting the Broadsword.
Pan: Given by merchants after talking to them enough times. Possible starting from the third run.
PrisonerGold: In the Specialist Shop, pay 10,000 golds or get 50 curses.
CavernKey: Found at the start of the level, behind the giant door. To opened it, you need to kill the Hand of the King.
P_Caltrops: Found in the chest at the entrance of a Rift Challenge.
DashShield: Behind the 2-minute timed door in the transition before the Promenade.
BackStabber: In a secret area on top of the Promenade's entrance.
P_AmmoOnHit: In a secret area on top of the Promenade's entrance, higher than Assassin's Dagger.
ExplosiveCrossBow: In a tower with three doors locked by Gardener's Keys. One key is in a vertical tower, another is under breakable ground, and for the last one, ground slam a rose multiple times.
P_SpeedHeal: Behind the 2-minute timed door in the transition before the Toxic Sewers.
P_SuperParry: In a secret area in the transition before Toxic Sewers, on the left side of the vertical passage.
PreciseBow: At the end on the right side of the level, if the last tower isn't the exit to Black Bridge and Stun Grenade hasn't generated, Nerves of Steel might spawn. It is located farther right, after an invisible platform.
StunningGrenade: At the end on the right side of the level, if the last tower isn't the exit to Black Bridge and Nerves of Steel hasn't generated, Stun Grenade might spawn. It is located below, on the right side of the tower.
LongBow: Behind the 8-minute timed door in the transition before the Ossuary, from the Promenade or the Castle Outskirts after beating Death.
P_Hot: In a secret area after a teleportation monolith.
AlchemicGun: In a secret area not guaranteed to spawn, after a passage with leaves leading to a pool of poisonous water.
WarriorShield: In a secret area under a deep pool of poisonous water with a false ground at the bottom.
Money5: In a secret maze in the ground.
RootBomb: Behind the 15-minute timed door in the transition after Black Bridge.
ParryShield: Located to the right of the elevator leading to the Clock Tower. A key is needed, so you should spare the first one by using a hidden passage on top of the door in the middle of the level.
SpawnLilStaphy: In a lore room, after beating the Elite Armored Shrimp.
ShipwreckKey: In a lore room, dropped after beating the Elite Armored Shrimp.
PortableDoor: In a lore room not guaranteed to spawn. This room contains a lot of doors, and you need to reach the end without breaking any.
P_Trap: In a secret area in the middle of the vertical passage with spikes at the bottom.
P_DeathBomb: In a secret area on the right end of the level. The Architect's Key is needed to open this area and can be found in a wall rune in the underground section. After Merchandise Categories, go into the secret area in the roof to open the door.
ShopCategories: In a secret area on the right end of the level. The Architect's Key is needed to open this area and can be found in a wall rune in the underground section.
Skul: Ground slam a special tombstone near the entrance of the underground section.
AreaShield: Locked behind the door needing the Bell Tower Key. To get the key, you need to ring the four bells from lowest to highest pitch. It can be done without audio using the sound waves: the lower the pitch, the further it goes.
P_EasierCurse: In a secret area after three doors locked by Moonflower Keys. You'll need to take the three Gardener's Keys in the Promenade, collect the first Moonflower Key in the Ramparts, and go to the Insufferable Crypt. From there, collect the second key in the Graveyard and the third in the Forgotten Sepulcher.
ShovelKnight: Break the Shovel Knight painting with the Shovel.
Boomerang: After the exit, use the third Castle Key on the last locked door.
ThrowingSpear: In a secret area near the exit, after the platforming section.
PrisonerSanta: Behind a four BSC door. Requires the Garland Key, hidden in a secret area in the roof.
SonicCrossbow: Found at the top of the exit tower and requiring the Apex Key. The Apex Key is located in a hidden tower, located under a corridor.
PrisonerGardener: In a lore room, after examining the chaise longue.
TickSacrifice: Use the Mushroom Boi! active skill in front of the sacrificial altar near the exit of Morass of the Banished, and do not attack Mama Tick in the Nest.
FlyingSword: In a secret area, after a platforming section on invisible platforms. The outline of the platforms can be seen with the rain particles.
Cultist: Dropped after examining the cultists' corpses on the floor.
BubbleShieldPower: Behind one of the three doors with special runes on it. The runes pointing out the right door are somewhere in the level, on small violet flags.
Trident: In a lore room locked by the Forked Key. Enemies in this level can randomly drop a map part, and with four of them an X symbol appears on the map. The Forked Key is in the breakable floor marked by the X.
BlueErinaceus: Complete the level in less than five minutes. The timer starts at the end of the cutscene and ends when the last servant is killed.
WiggleWhip: Do the Konami Code (up, up, down, down, left, right, left, right, B, A). On a controller, B is roll and A is jump. On a keyboard, use the arrow, B, and A keys.
Maria: Catch the cat wandering in the level to gain the Ribboned Key, and open Maria's cell. In there, talk to Maria.
SpawnCat: Catch the cat wandering in the level to gain the Ribboned Key, and open Maria's cell. In there, interact with the cat.
AlucardShield: In a secret area, to the right of your first encounter with Alucard.
Simon: In the lore room with Camilla's mask. Given after examining the mask.
Alucard: Talk to Alucard in the room before Dracula.
Sypha: In a secret area on top of the room before Dracula. An invisible platform on the right side of the room leads to the secret area. The outfit is given upon examining Sypha's robe.
Trevor: In a secret area on top of the room before Dracula. An invisible platform on the right side of the room leads to the secret area. The outfit is given upon examining Trevor's equipment.
Banker: Complete the platform challenge at the end of the green floor.
RiskOfRain: Kill the two shadow imps that spawn from the imp altar. The imps will flee as soon as they spawn and disappear after some time. The altar will randomly spawn in biomes.
SlayTheSpire: Collect the Emerald Key (from an elite room), the Sapphire Key (from a choice altar), and the Ruby Key (from a shop) in the same run.
HollowKnight: Use the downward slash of the Pure Nail to pogo 8 times without touching the ground.
Blasphemous: Use the Face Flask at very low HP.
Guacamelee: Kill the mob with any of the four items.
HyperLightDrifter: Wear the Drifter Outfit and pick up the Hard Light Sword.
CurseofTheDeadGods: Complete a run without taking any trap damage.
HotlineMiamiChicken: Kill an enemy with the Baseball Bat after stunning them by destroying a door.
KatanaZero: Kill 15 enemies with Hattori's Katana's dashing strike without getting hit.
BlobbyFlameGum: Spawn 100 biters in the same run.
EvilEmpire: Watch the end credits for some time.
BlackHole: Complete a run without ever getting hit.
Bitter: Defeat the Hand of the King with biters. Can be unlocked in the Training Room, and the last hit should be a direct attack from a biter.
VortexBadSeed: Complete any biome by killing every enemy without getting hit.
Guillain Head: Talk to every Guillain: Guillain (the one providing mutations), the Blacksmith's Apprentice (appears after defeating a boss), the Doctor (providing aspects), the Bank Teller (at the entrance of the Bank), and the Architect (in Boss Rush after unlocking the Boss Rush Statue).
StaphyHead: Complete a run without evolving a Leghugger.
Flawless: You need to kill almost every boss without getting hit. Return to Castlevania DLC bosses are excluded from this list.
CellHead: Carry 1,000 cells at the same time.
MushroomBoi: Complete the Dilapidated Arboretum with the Mushroom Boi! without exploding him.
HordesZeroHood: Defeat the Hand of the King with a turret. Can be unlocked in the Training Room, and the last hit should be done with the projectile's damage, not its effect.
GlitchyHeadRed: Complete a run while still being cursed. Having the Cursed Sword counts for this.
BlowTorchBlack: Defeat a boss with less than 5% HP remaining.
BlowTorchGold: Have 200,000 gold at the same time.
BlowTorchRed: Defeat a boss with the Fire Blast.
DashSword: Complete the Daily Challenge three times.
HydraSpell: Complete the first trial of Boss Rush.
Taunt: Complete the second trial of Boss Rush.
P_Wishes: Complete the third trial of Boss Rush.
Mentor: Complete the second Boss Rush trial on 0 to 2 BSC.
Mentor1: Complete the third Boss Rush trial on 3 or 4 BSC.
Mentor2: Complete the second Boss Rush trial on 3 or 4 BSC.
Mentor3: Complete the second Boss Rush trial on 5 BSC without being hit.
VictoriusBeheaded: Complete the fourth Boss Rush trial on 0 to 2 BSC.
VictoriusBeheaded1: Complete the fourth Boss Rush trial on 3 or 4 BSC.
VictoriusBeheaded2: Complete the third Boss Rush trial on 5 BSC without being hit.
VictoriusBeheaded3: Complete the fourth Boss Rush trial on 5 BSC without being hit.
BossRushStatue: Found in the first chest opened at the end of any Boss Rush trial.
ASP: Restart or die to get a random aspect.
PQLoreRoom: Inside one of the lore rooms of the Prisoners' Quarters.
BossFlawless: The boss should be killed without taking a hit.
AmazonLoot: The corresponding servant needs to be killed last.
CursedBiome: This item is found in a cursed biome.
